description: This file defines the WMLEvent class, which models events in the Wesnoth Scenario Editor, including initialization, encoding/decoding, hierarchy management, and string export functionalities.

classes.name: WMLEvent
classes.description: Represents an event in the Wesnoth Scenario Editor, supporting hierarchy, serialization, and string export.

methods.name: initAsTag
methods.description: Initializes a WMLEvent as a tag with specified properties.

methods.name: initWithWMLTag
methods.description: Creates a WMLEvent hierarchy from a WMLTag hierarchy.

methods.name: encodeWithCoder
methods.description: Serializes the WMLEvent object.

methods.name: initWithCoder
methods.description: Deserializes the WMLEvent object.

methods.name: setEventName
methods.description: Sets the event's name.

methods.name: getEventName
methods.description: Returns the event's name.

methods.name: setEventValue
methods.description: Sets the event's value and string representation.

methods.name: getEventStringValue
methods.description: Returns the string value of the event based on its type.

methods.name: setEventIntValue
methods.description: Sets the integer value of the event.

methods.name: getEventIntValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value of the event.

methods.name: noEventChildren
methods.description: Returns the number of child events.

methods.name: addEventChild
methods.description: Adds a child event.

methods.name: removeEventChild
methods.description: Removes a specific child event.

methods.name: getEventChildAtIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a child event at a specific index.

methods.name: isEventATag
methods.description: Checks if the event is a tag.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: getEventParent
methods.description: Returns the parent event.

methods.name: setEventMapLoc
methods.description: Sets the map location associated with the event.

methods.name: getEventMapLoc
methods.description: Gets the map location of the event.

methods.name: getEventTag
methods.description: Returns the tag string of the event.

methods.name: exportEventToString
methods.description: Exports the event and its children as a formatted string.
